development_data.name: General-AgentBench published baseline prompts
development_data.usage: Router V5 may fit on these development prompts only. No Router V2, V3, or V4 external holdout task is reused for V5 scoring.

sampling_rule: For each VisualWebArena domain, load published task intents, compute SHA256(domain + '\n' + task_id + '\n' + intent), sort ascending by digest, and select the first 24. The rule is fixed before the first successful score.
label_visibility: The terminalbench family label is attached only after Router V4 and Router V5 predictions are produced.
primary_metric: Interactive-family Hit@1 over the balanced 72-task VisualWebArena holdout
secondary_metrics: Router V4 Hit@1 on the identical new holdout
anti_tuning_rule: After the first successful scored run, Router V5 algorithm, weights, source pin, sampling rule, and task counts are frozen for this holdout. Any changed router must become Router V6 with a new holdout.
evidence_boundary: This is interactive task-family routing transfer only. It does not claim native VisualWebArena environment success, action execution correctness, or visual grounding performance.
